overview.commentary: The portfolio returned 59.27% annualised against 25.78% volatility (Sharpe 1.76) — excellent risk-adjusted performance at a elevated risk level. HPE carries the largest weight at 2.9%; SNDK dominates risk contribution at 8.3%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.98% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 3.70% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -11.40%. Action: profile looks balanced; monitor correlation drift around the next earnings cycle.

risk.commentary: Monte Carlo (10k paths, 1Y horizon): 95% VaR 8.66%, 99% VaR 20.98%, CVaR 95% 16.27%. Probability of >20% loss: 1.17%. Worst historical replay is GFC_peak_to_trough (-57.29% return, max drawdown -58.05%, worst day -13.39%). GARCH(1,1) 30-day forecast vol is 23.37% vs realised 21.61% — vol regime rising. Persistence alarm: ARE, INTC, EG, MU, SNDK, TWLO, LITE, WDC, STX, TSN, GPN, EXE have α+β > 0.95, meaning shocks decay slowly — drawdowns there will compound longer than a Gaussian model would imply.

liquidity.commentary: AUM $1,000,000 across 47 positions. The most concentrated trade is ARE at 0.0% of 30-day ADV. At a 20% participation rate, the slowest unwind would be ARE at 0.0 trading days — manageable but worth keeping in mind for any rapid de-risk. Current sizing tracks Kelly recommendations closely.
